blocks.text: Klea Pineda revealed that she and Janella Salvador have been discussing marriage, sharing that a beach wedding is her dream ceremony. Pineda opened up about their wedding discussions to select media before receiving the LGBTQIA+ Influencer of the Year award at the 2026 RAWR Awards in Quezon City on Tuesday, Nov. 17. Asked if she and Salvador have been talking about getting married, the actress told reporters, “Of course naman.” “Sabi nga ni Janella sa interview niya, gugulatin na lang namin kayo. Malay niyo naman, di ba? Pero ’yun naman talaga ’yung goal namin,” she added. READ: Exes Klea Pineda, Katrice […]...
